subject: E-Commerce
title: The Abandoned Cart Email
description: A 60-second lesson on The Abandoned Cart Email.

hook.text: Abandoned cart emails recover 5-15% of lost sales. They're the highest-ROI emails in all of e-commerce.

buildup.text: The best cart emails send within 1 hour, show the exact items left behind, and include a clear CTA button.

discovery.text: Adding a small discount in the second email (sent 24 hours later) boosts recovery by another 10-20%.

twist.text: Savvy shoppers intentionally abandon carts to trigger discount emails. The tactic is becoming common.

climax.text: Cart recovery emails created a cat-and-mouse game. Sellers chase, smart buyers bait, and discounts grow.

punchline.text: 5-15% recovered by one email. Abandoned cart messages are e-commerce's best ROI.

quiz.question: When should the first abandoned cart email be sent?
